description: Legal Affairs Dept. - DFCC Bank (Repeal & Consequential Provisions) Act No. 39 of 2014 - Order under Section 02 - Specify January 06, 2015 as the date from which the DFCC Bank Act (Chapter 165) be repealed.
reasoning: This gazette content announces the repeal of the DFCC Bank Act through a legal order issued by the President, making it primarily about legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structure. It fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves the modification/repeal of existing legislation through statutory authority.
